extracted.name: Turkey Pozole
extracted.description: Turkey pozole is a great way to use up leftover holiday turkey. Garnish with crisp tortilla chips, shredded green cabbage, and a squeeze of lime.
ingredient_lines: 2 medium fresh poblano chile peppers, seeded and cut into 1/2 inch strips
2 (15 ounce) cans cannellini beans, drained and rinsed
1 (4 ounce) can chopped green chile peppers
instruction_lines: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat. Add onions and poblano chiles; cook and stir until soft, about 5 minutes. Add garlic; cook and stir until fragrant, 1 to 2 minutes. Stir in chile powder, cumin, and oregano.

Add turkey broth, turkey, cannellini beans, hominy, chile peppers, salt, and pepper. Add water just to cover, stir to combine, and bring to a boil. Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer, stirring occasionally, until flavors have blended, about 1 hour.
